entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
By the present petition, the petitioner who is original claimant in land acquisition proceeding and the respondent in first appeal (stamp) no.4670/2023 invoked jurisdiction of this Court under Section 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act and prayed for action against the respondent nos.1 and 2/contemnor for willful disobedience of order dated 13.02.2023 passed in civil application no.1867/2023 in first appeal (stamp) no.4670/2023.
2.

The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner canvassed that despite the order passed by this Court on 13.02.2023, the respondents/contemnor have not deposited the entire amount of compensation with interest within 12 weeks.
Therefore, the action on the part of the respondents amounts to Contempt of Court defined under Section 12 of (2) 922 cp 670.23 the Contempt of Courts Act.

3. Needless to say that on 13.02.2023, this Court passed an order in civil application no.1867/2023 in first appeal (stamp) no.4670/2023 which reads as under:
"Heard.
Chausarbai Shivlal Rajput vs Dr Pallavi Ambhore The Chief Executive ...

entities.text: Chausarbai Shivlal Rajput vs Dr Pallavi Ambhore
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Counsel Mr. Pahune Patil waives service on behalf of respondent no.1-claimant.
The learned AGP waives service for respondent no.2.
There shall be interim stay in terms of prayer clause (B), subject to deposit of entire amount of compensation along with interest within twelve weeks.
List First Appeal St. No.20725 of 2022 along with these matters."

4. Therefore, it appears that this Court granted conditional interim stay to the judgment and award passed by the Reference Court under the Land Acquisition Act and if there is failure to deposit the entire amount of compensation as per the said order in that event the stay may not be continued or in operation.

Therefore, the petitioner is having a remedy to execute the award by invoking Order XXI of C.P.C. However, I do not find that there is willful breach or disobedience of order dated 13.02.2023 passed by this Court at the hands of the respondents.
Therefore, I am not inclined to exercise the powers under Section 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act.
